title: Spiced Lentil Curry
description: A flavorful and nutritious Indian-inspired curry made with red lentils, aromatic spices, and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and ginger; sauté until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add curry powder and aromatic spices; cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add lentils, water, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro (optional).
